params.name: account_last4
params.description: Filter by the last 4 digits of the account if available.

params.name: account_routing_number
params.description: Filter by the account routing number if available.

params.name: after_cursor
params.description: Return every resource created after the cursor value.

params.name: before_cursor
params.description: Return every resource created before the cursor value.

params.name: bin
params.description: Filter by Bank Identification Number (BIN). The BIN is the first 6 digits of the masked number.

params.name: created_at.gte
params.description: Filter where `created_at` is after the given date.

params.name: created_at.lte
params.description: Filter where `created_at` is before the given date.

params.name: expiration_month
params.description: Filter by the expiration month associated with the `Payment Instrument` if applicable. This filter only applies to payment cards.

params.name: expiration_year
params.description: Filter by the 4 digit expiration year associated with the Payment Instrument if applicable. This filter only applies to payment cards.

params.name: last4
params.description: Filter by the last 4 digits of the `Payment Instrument` card. This filter only applies to payment cards.

params.name: limit
params.description: The numbers of items to return.

params.name: owner_identity_id
params.description: Filter by the owner id of the associated `Identity`.

items.docs:
Create a `Payment Instrument` resource using a card or bank account.

- The creation of `Payment Instruments` directly via Finix's API should only be done for testing purposes. You must use [our hosted fields](/guides/payments/making-a-payment/using-hosted-fields/) or the javascript client to remain out of PCI scope.
Retrieve the details of a `Payment Instrument`.

Update a `Payment Instrument` to:
- Change the **billing address** in case the account holder moved (`instrument_type`:**PAYMENT_CARD** only).
- Disable the `Payment Instrument` resource so it can't be used in requests.
- Update the `name` on the `Payment Instrument`.
- Change the `tags`.

Create an `apple_pay_session` to process Apple Pay transactions on the web.

To create an Apple Pay Session, pass the unique `validation_url` (provided by Apple) while creating an `apple_pay_sessions` resource. Finix returns a `merchantSession` object that you can use to create a payment. For more information, see [Apple Pay](/guides/payments/alternative-payment-methods/apple-pay/).
